summary: Executed iteration-4 backend+frontend verification on production URL for auth lockout, managed file storage/privacy, deep finance branches, referral channel classification, fixed-per-unit rule versioning, tablet menu visibility/toggle, and horizontal overflow at 360/390/430/768.
